title: Comic Strips
text:
A comic strip tells a short story with pictures. Most comic strips have three or four panels. Each panel shows one moment of the story. The words of the characters appear in speech bubbles.

Some comic strips are about animals. Others are about children or superheroes. Many artists draw comic strips for newspapers. Readers often wait each day for the next panel.

questions.text: How many panels do most comic strips have?
What are some comic strips about?
What is the main job of the speech bubbles?
options: To show what the characters say

questions.text: Why do readers often wait each day for the next panel?
options: They enjoy the story and want to know what happens
They must pay for each panel
The newspaper has no other pages
The artist is very slow to draw

vocabulary.definition: one square or box with a picture in a comic
the people or animals in a story
people who make pictures or other art
living things such as dogs, cats, or birds

paragraph_translations: Çizgi roman, resimlerle anlatılan kısa bir hikâyedir. Çoğu çizgi romanda üç veya dört kare bulunur. Her kare hikâyenin bir anını gösterir. Karakterlerin sözleri konuşma balonlarında görünür.

Bazı çizgi romanlar hayvanlarla ilgilidir. Diğerleri çocuklar ya da süper kahramanlar hakkındadır. Birçok sanatçı gazeteler için çizgi roman çizer. Okurlar genellikle her gün bir sonraki kareyi merakla bekler.
